name: Flat-Shouldered Jar with Four Loop-holes at Neck and with Decoration of a Figure Standing in a Garden
summary: 哈佛艺术博物馆著录：Chinese；1368-1644；Cizhou ware: light gray stoneware with decoration painted in underglaze brown slip on a white slip ground, with details touched on the surface of the clear glaze in russet-brown slip and olive-green glaze in localized areas, the unglazed lowest portion finished with dark brown glaze
